The physical structure (heel turn, cuff ribbing, tubular body) is biologically/physically plausible for socks. 8/9 checkpoints are clearly met; the 9th (toe reinforcement) is ambiguous but not failed.

The blue sock's cuff lacks a defined thickness/rim, merging into the background (Severity ~2.0). The green sock's toe shows slight loop fusion/blur (Severity ~1.5). The background plank has minor waviness. These issues prevent a perfect score but do not constitute catastrophic failure. The high mask confidence from SAM indicates the objects are segmented well, but the visual fidelity of the edges remains imperfect.
